rationale: Hapax in this corpus. Context (modifying ⲡⲙⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲉⲧⲁⲛⲍ̄ 'the living member' which abounds with light of souls; food-typology) supports a vegetative-vitality sense. Possible Lyc lexeme for 'sap, freshness, tenderness' of fresh living substance. Distinct from ⲗⲁⲓⲃⲉⲥ 'shadow' (Crum 138a). Confidence low; flag for parallels.

Recurring perfect-form (lines 6, 12-13) of motion-verb consistently paired with ⲉⲥⲧⲁⲓ̈ⲗⲉ ⲙ̄ⲡⲣⲏⲧⲉ ⲛ̄ⲟⲩⲍⲁⲗⲏⲧ 'mounted in the manner of a bird.' Possible analysis: ⲁⲥ-ⲉⲓ-ⲱⲟⲩ '(she) has come (in) glory' (ⲱⲟⲩ = ⲉⲟⲟⲩ 'glory') or compound stem of upward-flight motion. The bird-imagery anchors the verb in vertical-soteriological semantics consistent with ⲧⲟⲩⲱ 'raise.'
Likely qualitative of ϫⲱⲃ̄ 'be weak, slack' (Lyc ⲝ for ϫ). Modifies ⲛⲓⲉⲛⲑⲩⲙⲏⲥⲓⲥ in negative cluster with ⲉⲧϣⲧⲁⲣⲧⲣ̄ 'disturbed.' Captures the deficient/lethargic state of the dark-induced thoughts.

Modifier of ⲛⲓⲥⲃⲁⲩⲉ 'teachings' in opposition to the true teachings of line 11. Likely from ϩⲱⲗⲃ̄ 'deceit, deceive' family. Distinguishes the false counter-teachings from the apostle's authentic instruction.

Compound: ⲃⲓⲛ ('bad/evil') + ⲟⲩⲱⲙ ('eat'). Names food unfit for the elect; pair-partner with ⲧⲣⲟⲫⲏ in the food-typology of this kephalaion. The lower wells deliver bitter members through this 'bad-eating.'

Lyc variant of ϩⲁϫⲉ/ⲥⲁϣⲉ 'bitter.' Modifies ⲓ̈ⲙⲉⲗⲟⲥ 'the members' as antithetical pair to ⲉⲧⲁⲛⲓⲧ 'beautiful' (line 1). Direct gustatory-correspondential register: the bitter members are dark, the beautiful members are light-bearing.
Likely qualitative of ⲧⲁⲕⲣⲟ/ⲧⲁϫⲣⲟ 'be firm, established.' Modifier of ⲧⲣⲟⲫⲏ that has come properly when the lower wells are quieted. The 'firm food' is the proper Manichaean food-discipline.

proposed_english: those of the lower place / those below
rationale: Two variants of the same compound on this page (lines 20, 22): ⲛⲁ-ⲡⲓⲧⲛⲉ and ⲛⲁ-ⲧⲓⲧⲉ. Both designate the inhabitants/powers of the lower cosmic region, source of the disturbing wells. ⲛⲁⲧⲓⲧⲉ is a contracted/dialectal variant.
Variant of ⲙⲛⲧⲍⲁⲗⲟⲏⲧ 'gentleness' already in glossary. The -ⲃⲏⲧ ending (vs. -ⲟⲏⲧ) may be dialectal alternation. Disciple's praise of the apostle's gentle pastoral mode of teaching.
